   465	/-! ## The manufactured sections, side-uniformly
   466	
   467	`DivisorAdaptation.thetaSectionFst/Snd` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyThetaSections.lean:271/:278`)
   468	are the two sections `σ = (t₀ᵃ; 1)`, `τ = (1; t₁ᵃ)` whose pairing discharges
   469	`IsThetaPaired` chart-typed.  They read the `Sum` index to decide *which side's coordinate
   470	to use on this piece* — and that decision is again a `Bool`, so the side-uniform coordinate
   471	below carries them to the widened cover. -/
   472	
   473	section Sections
   474	
   475	/-- **The side-uniform coordinate power** `t_bᵃ` on the pinned chart of side `b`: `t₀ᵃ` on
   476	`false`, `t₁ᵃ` on `true`.  The `Bool`-indexed form of `relFiberCoordPow` /
   477	`relFiberCoordOnePow`, which the widened sections need for the same reason
   478	`relThetaResSide` was needed for the twisting unit. -/
   479	noncomputable def relFiberCoordSidePow (n : ℕ) : ∀ b : Bool,
   480	    Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
   481	  | false => relFiberCoordPow C R π n
   482	  | true => relFiberCoordOnePow C R π n
   483	
   484	@[simp]
   485	lemma relFiberCoordSidePow_false (n : ℕ) :
   486	    relFiberCoordSidePow (C := C) (R := R) (π := π) n false
   487	      = relFiberCoordPow C R π n := rfl
   488	
   489	@[simp]
   490	lemma relFiberCoordSidePow_true (n : ℕ) :
   491	    relFiberCoordSidePow (C := C) (R := R) (π := π) n true

   561	full equalizer algebra.  Named so the remaining (c2)-transport obligation over the widened
   562	carrier is a *statement in the tree* rather than a gap in prose.

   564	**This is not proved here, and the reason is precise.** Chart-typed, it is discharged by

   569	coordinates suffice is the open question. -/
   570	def IsThetaPaired : Prop :=

   575	    (h : (1 : A.chartProd) ∈ thetaSpan A τ a * thetaInvSpan A τ a) :
   576	    IsThetaPaired A τ a := by
   577	  refine le_antisymm (thetaSpan_mul_thetaInvSpan_le_one A τ a) ?_

   582	
   583	`IsThetaPaired` is a `Prop` this file defines and does not prove, so per the standing
   584	discipline it owes **two** probes.  "Not silently stronger" is discharged by
   585	`thetaSpan_mul_thetaInvSpan_le_one`: the automatic half is landed, so the content is exactly
   586	the reverse inclusion, the same content as chart-typed.

   588	The mirror risk is **unsatisfiability** — a `Prop` no widened cover can ever satisfy would make
   589	every consumer of it a vacuous theorem, which passes every `sorry` census and axiom probe.  The
   590	probe below rules that out with an unconditional witness, so the residue is genuinely open
   591	rather than false. -/
   592	
   593	/-- **THE SATISFIABILITY PROBE, DISCHARGED at the trivial twist.**  At `a = 0` the theta
   594	cocycle is `1`, so every `thetaOvlUnit` is `1`, both spans are the equalizer algebra itself, and
   595	the pairing holds **unconditionally** — for every widened cover, every adaptation and every
   596	chart typing.
   597	
   598	This does not make the pairing easy at `a > 0`: the content there is the manufactured sections,
   599	which is the open obligation. What it establishes is that `IsThetaPaired` is *satisfiable*, i.e.
   600	that the widened statement is not a reduction to a false hypothesis. -/
   601	theorem isThetaPaired_zero : IsThetaPaired A τ 0 := by
   602	  refine isThetaPaired_of_one_mem A τ 0 ?_
   603	  -- at the trivial twist both spans contain `1`

   605	    rw [mem_unitGluedSubmodule_iff]
   606	    intro p
   607	    rw [thetaOvlUnit_zero τ p.1 p.2]
   608	    rw [Pi.one_apply, Pi.one_apply, map_one, map_one, Units.val_one, map_one, mul_one]
   609	  have hinvunit : (thetaOvlUnit τ 0)⁻¹
   610	      = (thetaOvlUnit τ 0 : ∀ i j : D.index,
   611	          Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)ˣ) := by
   612	    funext i j
   613	    rw [Pi.inv_apply, Pi.inv_apply, thetaOvlUnit_zero τ i j, inv_one]
   614	  have hinv : (1 : A.chartProd) ∈ unitGluedSubmodule A (thetaOvlUnit τ 0)⁻¹ := by
   615	    rw [hinvunit]; exact hone
   616	  have := Submodule.mul_mem_mul (mem_thetaSpan_iff A τ 0 |>.mpr hone)
   617	    (mem_thetaInvSpan_iff A τ 0 |>.mpr hinv)

Pure\\n    62\\talgebra; the finiteness route for the concrete colength `N z`. -/\\n    63\\ttheorem Module.Finite.span_range_of_finite_isScalarTower\\n    64\\t    {R S M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]\\n    65\\t    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]\\n    66\\t    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]\\n    67\\t    (f : M \u2192\u2097[R] N) :\\n    68\\t    Module.Finite S (Submodule.span S (Set.range f)) := by\\n    69\\t  obtain \u27e8T, hT\u27e9 := (Module.Finite.fg_top (R := R) (M := M))\\n    70\\t  have hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range f) = Submodule.span S (f '' T) := by\\n    71\\t    apply le_antisymm\\n    72\\t    \u00b7 rw [Submodule.span_le]\\n    73\\t      rintro _ \u27e8m, rfl\u27e9\\n    74\\t      have hm : m \u2208 Submodule.span R (T : Set M) := by rw [hT]; trivial\\n    75\\t      have hfm : f m \u2208 Submodule.span R (f '' T) := by\\n    76\\t        rw [\u2190 Submodule.map_span]\\n    77\\t        exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hm\\n    78\\t      exact (Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars R S (f '' T)) hfm\\n    79\\t    \u00b7 exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_subset_range f T)\\n    80\\t  rw [hspan]\\n    81\\t  exact Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr (Submodule.fg_span (T.finite_toSet.image f))\\n    82\\t\\n    83\\tnamespace AlgebraicGeometry\\n    84\\t\\n    85\\tattribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra\\n    86\\t\\n    87\\tvariable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}\\n    88\\tvariable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]\\n    89\\tvariable {\u03c0 : C.left \u27f6 P1 k} [IsFinite \u03c0] {a : \u2115}\\n    90\\t\\n    91\\tnamespace ThetaGeneratorSeed\\n    92\\t\\n    93\\t/-! ## The concrete chart-level colength `N z` -/\\n    94\\t\\n    95\\t/-- **The concrete chart-level colength `N z`** (I-0302 \u00a7residual 2a): the `\u0393(V)`-submodule of\\n    96\\tthe colength ring `\u0393(V) \u29f8 \u27e8read s\u27e9` generated by the chart readings `read \u03c8` of the submodule\\n    97\\t`K`, where `V = relPinnedChart C R \u03c0 b` and `read = relThetaResSide a b le_rfl` (`le_rfl`,\\n    98\\t`h z`-free).  A section `h \u2208 \u0393(V)` annihilates `N z` exactly when `h \u00b7 (read \u03c8) \u2208 \u27e8read s\u27e9` for\\n    99\\tevery `\u03c8 \u2208 K` \u2014 the ann containment the redesigned `hdvd` consumes. -/\\n   100\\tnoncomputable def chartColengthModule (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R \u03c0 a)) (b : Bool)\\n   101\\t    (s : relThetaSections C R \u03c0 a) :\\n   102\\t    Submodule \u0393(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R \u03c0 b)\\n   103\\t      (\u0393(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R \u03c0 b) \u29f8\\n   104\\t        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s}) :=\\n   105\\t  Submodule.span _ (Set.range\\n   106\\t    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk\u2090 R (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp\\n   107\\t      (chartReadMap K b)))\\n   108\\t\\n   109\\t/-- The class of a chart reading of a `K`-element lies in `N z`. -/\\n   110\\ttheorem mk_relThetaResSide_mem_chartColengthModule\\n   111\\t    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R \u03c0 a)) (b : Bool)\\n   112\\t    (s : relThetaSections C R \u03c0 a) {\u03c8 : relThetaSections C R \u03c0 a} (h\u03c8 : \u03c8 \u2208 K) :\\n   113\\t    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})\\n   114\\t        (relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) \u03c8) \u2208 chartColengthModule K b s :=\\n   115\\t  Submodule.subset_span \u27e8\u27e8\u03c8, h\u03c8\u27e9, rfl\u27e9\\n   116\\t\\n   117\\t/-- **`N z` is a finite `\u0393(V)`-module**: from the reusable finiteness core, since `K` is a\\n   118\\tfinite `R`-module (the chart readings of a finite generating set of `K` span `N z`). -/\\n   119\\ttheorem chartColengthModule_finite (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R \u03c0 a)) (b : Bool)\\n   120\\t    (s : relThetaSections C R \u03c0 a) [Module.Finite R \u21a5K] :\\n   121\\t    Module.Finite \u0393(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R \u03c0 b) \u21a5(chartColengthModule K b s) :=\\n   122\\t  Module.Finite.span_range_of_finite_isScalarTower _\\n   123\\t\\n   124\\t/-! ## The ann\u2192hdvd bridge -/\\n   125\\t\\n   126\\t/-- **The ann\u2192hdvd bridge** (I-0302 \u00a7residual 2a): if `h \u2208 \u0393(V)` annihilates the colength\\n   127\\t`N z = chartColengthModule K b s`, then `h \u00b7 (read \u03c8) \u2208 \u27e8read s\u27e9` for every `\u03c8 \u2208 K` \u2014 the ann\\n   128\\tcontainment (`hann` shape) the redesigned `isGenerator_of_ann_cutter` consumes. ## The ann-cutter, seed-shaped (RD-N \u27f9 the cutter `h z`) -/\\n   153\\t\\n   154\\tset_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in\\n   155\\t-- the ann-cutter application over the heavy `relCurve` chart section ring re-synthesizes the\\n   156\\t-- finite-module / support instances past the default synthesis budget\\n   157\\t/-- **The ann-based fibre-cutter, seed-shaped** (I-0302 \u00a7residual 2a\u2192ann-cutter): from **RD-N\\n   158\\tproper** \u2014 the support-avoidance `primeIdealOf z \u2209 Module.support \u0393(V) (N z)` for the concrete\\n   159\\tcolength `N z = chartColengthModule K b s` at a point `z` in the chart `V = relPinnedChart C R \u03c0 b`\\n   160\\t\u2014 there is a section `h \u2208 \u0393(V)` with `z \u2208 D(h)` and `h \u00b7 (read \u03c8) \u2208 \u27e8read s\u27e9` for every `\u03c8 \u2208 K`.\\n   161\\t\\n   162\\tThis packages the landed ann-cutter engine `IsAffineOpen.exists_mem_basicOpen_forall_smul_eq_zero`\\n   163\\twith the ann\u2192hdvd bridge: the engine gives `h` annihilating `N z` with `z \u2208 D(h)`, and the bridge\\n   164\\tturns `h \u00b7 N z = 0` into the seed's `hann` containment.    142	private lemma exists_comp_localizedMap_eq_id [Module.Finite R P] [Module.Finite R N]
   143	    [Module.Flat R N] (ψ : P →ₗ[R] N) (J : Ideal R) [J.IsMaximal]
   144	    (hfib : Function.Injective (ψ.rTensor J.ResidueField)) :
   145	    ∃ l' : LocalizedModule J.primeCompl N →ₗ[Localization.AtPrime J]
   146	        LocalizedModule J.primeCompl P,
   147	      l' ∘ₗ LocalizedModule.map J.primeCompl ψ = LinearMap.id := by
   148	  haveI : Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime J) (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl P) :=
   149	    Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule J.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap J.primeCompl P)
   150	  haveI : Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime J) (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl N) :=
   151	    Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule J.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap J.primeCompl N)

   153	    Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
   154	  exact (IsLocalRing.split_injective_iff_lTensor_residueField_injective
   155	    (LocalizedModule.map J.primeCompl ψ)).mpr
   156	    (injective_lTensor_residueField_localizedMap J ψ hfib)

   158	/-- **Fibrewise injective into finite flat ⟹ projective**: a finitely presented module
   159	admitting a linear map to a finite flat module that is injective on every residue-field
   160	fibre is projective (hence flat). Mathlib-general; no Noetherian hypothesis. -/
   161	theorem Module.Projective.of_forall_rTensor_residueField_injective
   162	    [Module.FinitePresentation R P] [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Flat R N] (ψ : P →ₗ[R] N)
   163	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
   164	      Function.Injective (ψ.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
   165	    Module.Projective R P := by
   166	  refine Module.projective_of_localization_maximal (fun J hJ => ?_)
   167	  haveI : Module.Projective (Localization.AtPrime J) (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl N) := by
   168	    haveI : Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime J) (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl N) :=
   169	      Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule J.primeCompl
   170	        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap J.primeCompl N)
   171	    haveI : Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime J) (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl N) :=
   172	      Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
   173	    infer_instance
   174	  obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := exists_comp_localizedMap_eq_id ψ J (hfib ⟨J, hJ.isPrime⟩)
   175	  exact Module.Projective.of_split _ _ hl'

   177	/-- **Fibrewise injective ⟹ injective** for a map from a finite module to a finite flat
   178	module (injectivity is checked at maximal localizations, where the map splits). -/
   179	theorem LinearMap.injective_of_forall_rTensor_residueField_injective
   180	    [Module.Finite R P] [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Flat R N] (ψ : P →ₗ[R] N)
   181	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
   182	      Function.Injective (ψ.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
   183	    Function.Injective ψ := by
   184	  apply injective_of_localized_maximal
   185	  intro J hJ
   186	  obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := exists_comp_localizedMap_eq_id ψ J (hfib ⟨J, hJ.isPrime⟩)
   187	  exact Function.HasLeftInverse.injective ⟨l', LinearMap.congr_fun hl'⟩
   188	
   189	/-- **Fibrewise injective ⟹ flat cokernel**: for `ψ : P → N` with `P` finite, `N` finite
   190	flat and `ψ ⊗ κ(p)` injective at every prime, the cokernel `N ⧸ range ψ` is flat (locally
   191	it is even free, by `Module.free_of_lTensor_residueField_injective`). -/
   192	theorem Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_rTensor_residueField_injective
   193	    [Module.Finite R P] [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Flat R N] (ψ : P →ₗ[R] N)
   194	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
   195	      Function.Injective (ψ.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
   196	    Module.Flat R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ) := by
   197	  apply Module.flat_of_localized_maximal
   198	  intro J hJ
   199	  haveI : Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime J) (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl P) :=
   200	    Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule J.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap J.primeCompl P)
   201	  haveI : Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime J) (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl N) :=
   202	    Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule J.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap J.primeCompl N)
   203	  haveI : Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime J) (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl N) :=
   204	    Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
   205	  haveI : Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime J)
   206	      (LocalizedModule J.primeCompl (N ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ)) :=
   207	    Module.free_of_lTensor_residueField_injective
   208	      (LocalizedModule.map J.primeCompl ψ)
   209	      (LocalizedModule.map J.primeCompl (LinearMap.range ψ).mkQ)
   210	      (LocalizedModule.map_surjective _ _ (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _))
   211	      (LocalizedModule.map_exact _ _ _ ψ.exact_map_mkQ_range)
   212	      (injective_lTensor_residueField_localizedMap J ψ (hfib ⟨J, hJ.isPrime⟩))
   213	  exact Module.Flat.trans R (Localization.AtPrime J) _
   214

    11	# DD-4 (Task 4, (c2)-transport) — discharge of the pairing input `IsThetaPaired`
    12	
    13	The affine-colength-scheme trivialization (inbox I-0199 route 1, realized without any
    14	sheaf-theoretic localization brick): the colength scheme is *finite* over the base, so
    15	the chart-1 coordinate `t₁` is **integral over `R`** in every chart-1 colength algebra
    16	(certificate clause (c1)).  A single monic annihilator `p` of all the `t₁`-images
    17	(`exists_monic_forall_aeval_eq_zero`) turns, through the reciprocal-witness identity
    18	(`Polynomial.Monic.mul_aeval_neg_divX_reverse`) and the overlap relation `t₀ · t₁ = 1`,
    19	into a *global chart-0 section* `H = q(t₀)` with `t₀ · H ≡ 1` on every cross-overlap
    20	colength — the algebraic partition of unity subordinate to the two coordinate loci.
    21	The manufactured inverse-twisted glued families
    22	
    23	* `u' = (Hᵃ on the chart-0 pieces; 1 on the chart-1 pieces)` and
    24	* `v' = (1 − (t₀·H)ᵃ on the chart-0 pieces; 0 on the chart-1 pieces)`
    25	
    26	satisfy the `Θ⁻ᵃ`-twisted matching, and pair against the manufactured theta sections
    27	`σ = (t₀ᵃ; 1)`, `τ = (1; t₁ᵃ)` to `σ·u' + τ·v' = 1` — exactly the witness shape of

    31	  inverse-twisted sections attached to a chart-0 gauge `H`.

    34	* `DivisorAdaptation.isThetaPaired_of_finite_colength` — **the discharge**: finiteness

   108	      ((relCurve C R).resHom hW1 (relFiberCoordOnePow C R π 1))) p = 0) :

   110	      (relFiberCoordPow C R π 1
   111	        * Polynomial.aeval (relFiberCoordPow C R π 1) (-p.reverse.divX))) = 1 := by

   116	        ((relCurve C R).resHom hW1 (relFiberCoordOnePow C R π 1)) = 1 := by

   178	    (hovl : ∀ (i₀ : Fin A.m₀) (j₁ : Fin A.m₁),
   179	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁))
   180	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_left.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i₀))
   181	          (relFiberCoordPow C R π 1 * H)) = 1)
   182	    (hovl' : ∀ (j₁ : Fin A.m₁) (i₀ : Fin A.m₀),
   183	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inr j₁) (Sum.inl i₀))
   184	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i₀))
   185	          (relFiberCoordPow C R π 1 * H)) = 1) :
   186	    A.thetaInvSectionFst a H ∈ A.unitGluedSubmodule (A.thetaOvlUnit a)⁻¹ := by
   187	  rw [mem_unitGluedSubmodule_iff]
   188	  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
   189	  rcases i with i₀ | i₁ <;> rcases j with j₀ | j₁
   190	  · -- chart 0 / chart 0: both components restrict from `Hᵃ`
   191	    rw [thetaInvSectionFst_inl, thetaInvSectionFst_inl, toOvlLeft_mk, toOvlRight_mk]
   192	    simp only [Pi.inv_apply]
   193	    rw [FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_inl_inl, inv_one, Units.val_one, map_one, one_mul,
   194	      Scheme.resHom_resHom, Scheme.resHom_resHom]

   196	    rw [thetaInvSectionFst_inl, thetaInvSectionFst_inr, toOvlLeft_mk, map_one, mul_one]
   197	    simp only [Pi.inv_apply]
   198	    rw [FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_inl_inr, val_unitsRestrict_inv, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   199	    -- both sides invert the same element, hence agree
   200	    have hx : Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁))
   201	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_left.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i₀)) (H ^ a))
   202	        * Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁))
   203	          ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_left.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i₀))
   204	            (relFiberCoordPow C R π a)) = 1 := by
   205	      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← relFiberCoordPow_one_pow C R π a, ← mul_pow,
   206	        mul_comm H (relFiberCoordPow C R π 1), map_pow, map_pow, hovl i₀ j₁, one_pow]
   207	    have hy : Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁))

   209	          (relFiberCoordPow C R π a))
   210	        * Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁))
   211	          ((relCurve C R).resHom
   212	            (inf_le_inf (A.pieces_inl_le i₀) (A.pieces_inr_le j₁))
   213	            (((relThetaCocycle C R π a)⁻¹ :
   214	              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   215	                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
   216	              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   217	                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) = 1 := by
   218	      rw [← map_mul,
   219	        ← Scheme.resHom_resHom inf_le_left
   220	          (inf_le_inf (A.pieces_inl_le i₀) (A.pieces_inr_le j₁))
   221	          (relFiberCoordPow C R π a),
   222	        resHom_relFiberCoordPow C R π a, ← map_mul, Units.mul_inv, map_one, map_one]
   223	    exact left_inv_eq_right_inv hx hy
   224	  · -- chart 1 / chart 0: the twisting unit against the gauge power is the reciprocal
   225	    rw [thetaInvSectionFst_inr, thetaInvSectionFst_inl, map_one, toOvlRight_mk]
   226	    simp only [Pi.inv_apply]
   227	    rw [FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_inr_inl, inv_inv, val_unitsRestrict',
   228	      Scheme.resHom_resHom, ← resHom_relFiberCoordPow C R π a, Scheme.resHom_resHom,
   229	      ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← relFiberCoordPow_one_pow C R π a, ← mul_pow,
   230	      map_pow, map_pow, hovl' i₁ j₀, one_pow]
   231	  · -- chart 1 / chart 1: both components are `1`
   232	    rw [thetaInvSectionFst_inr, thetaInvSectionFst_inr, map_one, map_one]
   233	    simp only [Pi.inv_apply]
   234	    rw [FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_inr_inr, inv_one, Units.val_one, map_one, mul_one]

   237	cross-overlap colengths. -/

   239	    (hovl : ∀ (i₀ : Fin A.m₀) (j₁ : Fin A.m₁),

   275	      + A.thetaSectionSnd a * A.thetaInvSectionSnd a H = 1 := by
   276	  funext j

   290	/-- **The gauge form of the pairing discharge**: any global chart-0 section `H` with
   291	`t₀ · H ≡ 1` on all cross-overlap colengths discharges `IsThetaPaired`. -/
   292	theorem isThetaPaired_of_coordInverse
   293	    (hovl : ∀ (i₀ : Fin A.m₀) (j₁ : Fin A.m₁),
   294	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁))

   297	    (hovl' : ∀ (j₁ : Fin A.m₁) (i₀ : Fin A.m₀),

   305	/-- **The pairing input holds** (DD-4 Task 4, the (c2)-transport residual of I-0199):
   306	finiteness of the chart-1 colength modules over `R` — certificate clause (c1) on the
   307	chart-1 pieces — discharges `IsThetaPaired` for every twist exponent.  The chart-1
   308	coordinate is integral over `R` in every chart-1 colength, one monic annihilator serves
   309	all pieces, and its reciprocal witness is the global chart-0 gauge. -/
   310	theorem isThetaPaired_of_finite_colength
   311	    (hfin : ∀ j₁ : Fin A.m₁, Module.Finite R (A.colength (Sum.inr j₁))) :
   312	    A.IsThetaPaired a := by
   313	  have hint : ∀ j₁ : Fin A.m₁, _root_.IsIntegral R
   314	      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn (Sum.inr j₁)})
   315	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (A.pieces_inr_le j₁) (relFiberCoordOnePow C R π 1))) :=
   316	    fun j₁ => by
   317	      haveI := hfin j₁
   318	      exact _root_.IsIntegral.of_finite R _
   319	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hz⟩ := exists_monic_forall_aeval_eq_zero hint
   320	  refine A.isThetaPaired_of_coordInverse a
   321	    (H := Polynomial.aeval (relFiberCoordPow C R π 1) (-p.reverse.divX))
   322	    (fun i₀ j₁ => ?_) (fun j₁ i₀ => ?_)
   323	  · -- transport the annihilator into the overlap colength through `toOvlRight`
   324	    have hw : Polynomial.aeval (Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁))
   325	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inr_le j₁))
   326	          (relFiberCoordOnePow C R π 1))) p = 0 := by
   327	      have h : Polynomial.aeval (A.toOvlRight (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁)
   328	          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn (Sum.inr j₁)})
   329	            ((relCurve C R).resHom (A.pieces_inr_le j₁)
   330	              (relFiberCoordOnePow C R π 1)))) p = 0 := by

   332	      rwa [toOvlRight_mk, Scheme.resHom_resHom] at h
   333	    exact A.mk_ovlIdeal_coord_mul_aeval_eq_one hp (Sum.inl i₀) (Sum.inr j₁)
   334	      (inf_le_left.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i₀))
   335	      (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inr_le j₁)) hw
   336	  · -- the mirrored transport through `toOvlLeft`
   337	    have hw : Polynomial.aeval (Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal (Sum.inr j₁) (Sum.inl i₀))
   338	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_left.trans (A.pieces_inr_le j₁))
   339	          (relFiberCoordOnePow C R π 1))) p = 0 := by

   341	          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn (Sum.inr j₁)})
   342	            ((relCurve C R).resHom (A.pieces_inr_le j₁)
   343	              (relFiberCoordOnePow C R π 1)))) p = 0 := by
   344	        rw [Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, hz j₁, map_zero]
   345	      rwa [toOvlLeft_mk, Scheme.resHom_resHom] at h
   346	    exact A.mk_ovlIdeal_coord_mul_aeval_eq_one hp (Sum.inr j₁) (Sum.inl i₀)
   347	      (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i₀))
   348	      (inf_le_left.trans (A.pieces_inr_le j₁)) hw

    10	/-!
    11	# `SwallowedBy` from the Stacks `0B8B` input ALONE (R2, human decision I-0492)
    12	
    13	`AffCoverData.SwallowedBy` (`DivisorFamilyAffSwallow.lean`) is the hypothesis that some piece
    14	contains the whole support locus **and every other piece misses it**.  Stated that way it looks
    15	like two inputs, and `DivisorFamilyAffSwallow.lean`'s `ofSwallowingPiece` assembles a cover from
    16	a straddling affine open `W` plus an arbitrary cover of the rest — leaving `SwallowedBy` itself
    17	still to be supplied.
    18	
    19	**The second half is free.**  The support locus is CLOSED (`Scheme.LocalEquations.
    20	isClosed_supportLocus`), so its complement is open; choose the other pieces inside that
    21	complement and they miss the support by construction.  Since affine opens are a basis and the
    22	relative curve is quasi-compact for a proper `C` (`DivisorFamilyAffExtraction.lean`), such a
    23	family exists and is finite.
    24	
    25	So the ONLY geometric input `SwallowedBy` needs is the Stacks `0B8B` half:
    26	
    27	> `supp D` is finite over `R`, hence lies in a single affine open `W` of `C ×_k Spec R`.
    28	
    29	which is exactly what protection I-0492 clause 2 says to USE rather than re-derive.  This file
    30	narrows the obligation to that one statement and discharges everything around it.
    31	
    32	## Main declarations
    33	
    34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffCoverData.swallowedBy_ofSwallowingPiece` — `SwallowedBy` for the explicit
    35	  `ofSwallowingPiece` cover, when the other pieces avoid the support.
    36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affCoverData_swallowedBy` — from an affine open `W ⊇ supp d`, a
    37	  widened cover with `W` as a piece which `SwallowedBy d`.
    38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affAdaptation_swallowedBy` — the same **carrying an adaptation**, from
    39	  the *subordinate* form of the input (`W` inside one member of `d.cover`).  `AffAdaptation` needs
    40	  subordination and the bare containment does not give it — see the section comment there.
    41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isCertified_of_swallowing_affineOpen` — the endpoint: the two named
    42	  geometric inputs plus the rank datum give a widened cover, an adaptation, and **all seven**
    43	  certificate clauses, with no hypothesis on `|P¹(k)|` anywhere in the chain.
    44	-/
    45

    65	/-- **`SwallowedBy` for the explicit straddling cover**, given that the other pieces avoid the
    66	support.  This is bookkeeping over `Fin.snoc`: the last piece is `W`, which contains the
    67	support; every other index is a `castSucc`, whose piece is disjoint from it. -/
    68	theorem swallowedBy_ofSwallowingPiece {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    69	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) {m : ℕ}
    70	    {Ws : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens} (hWs : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (Ws i))
    71	    (hcover : W ⊔ (⨆ i, Ws i) = ⊤)
    72	    (hsub : d.supportLocus ⊆ (W : Set (relCurve C R)))
    73	    (hmiss : ∀ i, Disjoint d.supportLocus (Ws i : Set (relCurve C R))) :
    74	    (ofSwallowingPiece W hW Ws hWs hcover).SwallowedBy d := by
    75	  refine ⟨Fin.last m, ?_, ?_⟩
    76	  · change d.supportLocus ⊆ ((Fin.snoc Ws W : Fin (m + 1) → _) (Fin.last m) : Set _)
    77	    rw [Fin.snoc_last]
    78	    exact hsub
    79	  · intro j hj
    80	    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hj
    81	    change Disjoint d.supportLocus ((Fin.snoc Ws W : Fin (m + 1) → _) i.castSucc : Set _)
    82	    rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
    83	    exact hmiss i

    87	/-- **`SwallowedBy` from the Stacks `0B8B` input alone.**  Given an affine open `W` containing
    88	the support locus — the one geometric datum protection I-0492 clause 2 directs the lane to use
    89	rather than re-derive — there IS a widened cover swallowed by `d`.
    90	
    91	The rest is free, and the reason is that the support locus is CLOSED: cover the complement
    92	`supportLocusᶜ`, which is open, by affine opens contained in it, so they miss the support by
    93	construction; quasi-compactness (free for proper `C`) makes the family finite.  No fibre
    94	analysis, no support tube, no packet idempotent, and no chart. -/
    95	theorem exists_affCoverData_swallowedBy [IsProper C.hom]
    96	    (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    97	    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hsub : d.supportLocus ⊆ (W : Set (relCurve C R))) :
    98	    ∃ D : AffCoverData C R, D.SwallowedBy d := by
    99	  classical
   100	  -- (the cover produced here is swallowed; whether it also carries an ADAPTATION is a
   101	  -- separate question, answered by `exists_affAdaptation_swallowedBy` below)
   102	  -- the complement of the support is open, and contains everything outside `W`
   103	  let U : (relCurve C R).Opens := ⟨d.supportLocusᶜ, d.isClosed_supportLocus.isOpen_compl⟩
   104	  -- an affine open inside `U` around each point of `U`
   105	  have hV : ∀ z : U, ∃ V : (relCurve C R).Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧ (z : relCurve C R) ∈ V
   106	      ∧ V ≤ U := by
   107	    intro z
   108	    obtain ⟨V, hVmem, hzV, hVle⟩ :=
   109	      Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp (relCurve C R).isBasis_affineOpens z.2
   110	    exact ⟨V, hVmem, hzV, hVle⟩
   111	  choose V hVaff hzV hVle using hV
   112	  -- `W` together with those affine opens covers the curve: a point is in the support (hence in
   113	  -- `W`) or in `U`
   114	  have hcov : (Set.univ : Set (relCurve C R)) ⊆
   115	      (W : Set (relCurve C R)) ∪ ⋃ z : U, (V z : Set (relCurve C R)) := by
   116	    intro z _
   117	    by_cases hz : z ∈ d.supportLocus
   118	    · exact Or.inl (hsub hz)
   119	    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, hzV ⟨z, hz⟩⟩)
   120	  -- extract a finite subfamily of the `V`s
   121	  have hWU : IsCompact ((W : Set (relCurve C R))ᶜ) :=
   122	    (isClosed_compl_iff.mpr W.isOpen).isCompact
   123	  have hsubU : (W : Set (relCurve C R))ᶜ ⊆ ⋃ z : U, (V z : Set (relCurve C R)) := by
   124	    intro z hz
   125	    rcases hcov (Set.mem_univ z) with h | h
   126	    · exact absurd h hz

    94	/-! ## Every overlap colength off the straddling diagonal vanishes -/
    95	
    96	/-- **An overlap involving a missing piece has vanishing colength.**  `SwallowedBy` says every
    97	piece other than `j₀` is disjoint from the support, and an overlap is contained in each of its
    98	two pieces, so it too misses the support. -/
    99	lemma subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy {j₀ : D.index}
   100	    (hmiss : ∀ j : D.index, j ≠ j₀ →
   101	      Disjoint d.supportLocus (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
   102	    (i j : D.index) (h : i ≠ j₀ ∨ j ≠ j₀) :
   103	    Subsingleton (A.ovlColength i j) := by
   104	  refine A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint i j fun z hz hsupp => ?_
   105	  rcases h with hi | hj
   106	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss i hi)) hsupp hz.1
   107	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss j hj)) hsupp hz.2
   108	
   109	/-- **The difference arrow is identically zero on a straddling cover.**  On the diagonal it
   110	vanishes for every adaptation whatsoever (`deltaSub_apply_diag`, the I-0340 fact); off the
   111	diagonal the target is subsingleton, because a pair `(i, j)` with `i ≠ j` has at least one
   112	entry different from the straddling index. -/
   113	theorem deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
   114	    A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight = 0 := by
   115	  obtain ⟨j₀, _, hmiss⟩ := h
   116	  refine LinearMap.ext fun s => funext fun p => ?_
   117	  by_cases hp : p.1 = p.2
   118	  · -- diagonal: zero for every adaptation, by proof irrelevance on `inf_le_left/right`
   119	    obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := p
   120	    cases hp
   121	    exact A.deltaSub_apply_diag s i
   122	  · -- off-diagonal: at least one index misses the support, so the target is trivial
   123	    haveI : Subsingleton (A.ovlColength p.1 p.2) := by
   124	      by_cases h1 : p.1 = j₀
   125	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss p.1 p.2
   126	          (Or.inr fun h2 => hp (h1.trans h2.symm))
   127	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss p.1 p.2 (Or.inl h1)
   128	    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
   129

   131	
   132	/-- **The equalizer is everything**: with the difference arrow zero, every section glues. -/
   133	theorem gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
   134	    A.gluedSubmodule = ⊤ := by
   135	  rw [gluedSubmodule, A.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy h]
   136	  exact LinearMap.ker_zero
   137	
   138	/-- **Hence the glued module is the whole product of piece colengths.**  This is what makes
   139	(c2) a statement about the piece colengths — of which, on a straddling cover, all but the
   140	swallowing one are subsingleton. -/
   141	noncomputable def gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
   142	    A.Glued ≃ₗ[R] A.chartProd :=
   143	  (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (A.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy h)).trans
   144	    Submodule.topEquiv
   145	
   146	/-- **Clause (c3) is free on a straddling cover** — no fibrewise input, no Noetherian
   147	hypothesis, nothing.  The inclusion `W(d) ↪ ∏ colength` is onto, so its cokernel is trivial.
   148	This is the one part of this leaf's refuted original claim that was correct. -/
   149	theorem flat_coker_incl_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
   150	    Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) := by
   151	  haveI : Subsingleton (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) := by
   152	    rw [A.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy h]; infer_instance
   153	  haveI : Module.Free R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) :=
   154	    Module.Free.of_subsingleton R _
   155	  exact Module.Flat.of_free

   157	/-- **Clause (c2)-finiteness reduces to the piece colengths.** -/
   158	theorem finite_glued_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   159	    (hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)) :

   162	  haveI : Module.Finite R A.chartProd := Module.Finite.pi
   163	  exact Module.Finite.equiv (A.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy h).symm

   167	theorem projective_glued_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   168	    (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
   169	    Module.Projective R A.Glued := by
   170	  haveI := hproj
   171	  haveI : Module.Projective R A.chartProd :=
   172	    Module.Projective.of_equiv
   173	      (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype R D.index A.colength)
   174	  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (A.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy h).symm

   176	/-! ### The diagonal overlap IS the piece colength
   177	
   178	The identification the cert-collapse node calls "the one technical lemma still needed", in the
   179	only case the straddling shape leaves: the diagonal.  It is easier there than in general
   180	(`pieces i ⊓ pieces i = pieces i` needs no unit argument, only `inf_idem`) but it is NOT
   181	definitional — `Γ(pieces i ⊓ pieces i)` and `Γ(pieces i)` are different types, which is the
   182	`inf`-bookkeeping hazard the node flags.  So it goes through a genuine algebra equivalence. -/
   183	
   184	/-- The opens-level idempotence, named so the transports below can rewrite with it. -/
   185	lemma pieces_inf_self (i : D.index) : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i = D.pieces i := inf_idem _
   186	
   187	/-- **The diagonal overlap colength is the piece colength.**  Restriction along
   188	`pieces i ⊓ pieces i = pieces i` is an algebra isomorphism carrying the overlap ideal — whose
   189	two generators coincide there — onto `span {eqn i}`. -/
   190	noncomputable def sectionsInfSelfEquiv (i : D.index) :
   240	generated by the two restrictions of `eqn i` along `inf_le_left` and `inf_le_right` — which at
   241	`pieces i ⊓ pieces i` are the same proof of the same inequality, so the ideal is the span of a
   242	single element, and `sectionsInfSelfEquiv` carries it to `span {eqn i}`. -/
   243	noncomputable def ovlColengthDiagEquiv (i : D.index) :
   244	    A.ovlColength i i ≃ₐ[R] A.colength i :=
   245	  Ideal.quotientEquivAlg (A.ovlIdeal i i) (Ideal.span {A.eqn i})
   246	    (sectionsInfSelfEquiv i)
   247	    (by
   248	      rw [AffAdaptation.ovlIdeal, Ideal.map_span]
   249	      refine congrArg (Ideal.span) ?_
   250	      simp only [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
   251	      rw [sectionsInfSelfEquiv_ringHom_relResAlgHom i inf_le_left (A.eqn i)]
   252	      exact (Set.pair_eq_singleton (A.eqn i)).symm)
   253	
   254	/-- Hence flatness of the piece colengths gives flatness of the diagonal overlaps. -/
   255	theorem flat_ovlColength_diag_of_flat_colength (i : D.index)
   256	    [Module.Flat R (A.colength i)] :
   257	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength i i) :=
   258	  Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (A.ovlColengthDiagEquiv i).toLinearEquiv
   259	
   260	/-- **Clause (c4) reduces to flatness of the piece colengths alone.**  The difference arrow is
   261	zero, so its cokernel is `ovlProd` itself; every off-`j₀` factor is subsingleton, and the
   262	surviving factor `ovlColength j₀ j₀` is the diagonal overlap of the straddling piece, whose
   263	flatness is what the refutation identified as unavoidable.  It is supplied here as `hdiag`,
   264	one module rather than a whole cover — which is precisely the reduction the amended
   265	cert-collapse node claims. -/
   266	theorem flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy' (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   267	    (hdiag : ∀ i j : D.index, Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength i j)) :
   268	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) := by
   269	  haveI : ∀ p : D.index × D.index, Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength p.1 p.2) :=
   270	    fun p => hdiag p.1 p.2
   271	  haveI : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd := Module.Flat.pi_of_finite
   272	  have hrange : LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) = ⊥ := by
   273	    rw [A.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy h]; exact LinearMap.range_zero
   274	  rw [hrange]
   275	  exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot ⊥ rfl)
   276	
   277	/-- **Every overlap colength is flat, from (c1)-flatness alone.**  Two cases, exhausting the
   278	pairs: off the diagonal at least one index misses the support (straddling), so the overlap
   279	colength is subsingleton hence free; on the diagonal it IS the piece colength, by
   280	`ovlColengthDiagEquiv`.  This removes the last non-(c1) input from clause (c4). -/
   281	theorem flat_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   282	    (hflat : ∀ j, Module.Flat R (A.colength j)) (i j : D.index) :
   283	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength i j) := by
   284	  obtain ⟨j₀, _, hmiss⟩ := h
   285	  by_cases hij : i = j
   286	  · subst hij
   287	    haveI := hflat i
   288	    exact A.flat_ovlColength_diag_of_flat_colength i
   289	  · haveI : Subsingleton (A.ovlColength i j) := by
   290	      by_cases h1 : i = j₀

   294	    haveI : Module.Free R (A.ovlColength i j) := Module.Free.of_subsingleton R _
   295	    exact Module.Flat.of_free

   303	/-! ## The capstone: a certificate from (c1) and the rank alone
   304	
   305	This is what the reduction is FOR.  `DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`'s
   306	`isCertified_of_swallowedBy` had to take (c2)/(c3)/(c4) as hypotheses, because in general
   307	they are not free.  On a straddling cover they are not hypotheses at all: they follow from
   308	(c1) plus the flatness of the overlap colengths and the rank input. -/
   309	
   310	/-- **The full certificate on a straddling cover, from piece-level data only.**  Compare
   311	`AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy` (`DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`), which takes five
   312	glued hypotheses; here the only non-(c1) inputs are the overlap flatness the I-0340 refutation
